summary: `member get` (`GET /v1/member`) is annotated `pp:requires-tier: club-or-association` so live dogfood correctly classifies a regular-administration token's MEM_056 response as an expected tier gap rather than a command bug.
reason: Same pattern as `administration get`: the API itself scopes this endpoint to club/association administrations only (its own generated Short text already said so) and returns MEM_056 for every other account type. A live Phase 5 acceptance run with a real, non-club token surfaced this as a false-positive failure without the annotation.
validated_outcome: Live Phase 5 dogfood run with a real non-club/association token: `member get` reports skip (blocked-fixture: requires auth tier) instead of fail.
